value.rationale: The exact scheme structure resolves a natural tension between the recent ordinary-automorphism and derivation classifications. It identifies a genuine non-smoothness phenomenon, isolates the missing infinitesimal direction, and explains the severe loss of rational automorphisms over nonsquare parameters in nonperfect fields. This is a structural refinement rather than a routine parameter substitution.
